07.title: GRUDGE
description: • Programmed, Produced,  Mixed & Mastered by OrutO (SoundCreate / bethefool.)
• Additional Mastering: Gain (lowered for LUFS target), EQing

• Used VSTs & Samples: The first one is the horn used in the intro and outro, and the second one combines the glitch and vocal sample used in the pre-drop. (It actually says 'GRUDGE') Also, it has a growl-based sound like NIMDA, a tearout artist I respect.

• About this track: This song was made with the image of the Count of Monte Cristo I read when I was little. The Arabian-inspired melody that appears in both the intro and outro represents Edmond’s wealth. In the intro, it represents the fortune he had before his downfall, while its return in the outro represents the wealth he gains after carrying out his revenge. I wanted the melody to create a sense of coming full circle, connecting the beginning and the end of his story. As the intro transitions into the buildup, the music represents Edmond’s sudden downfall and the loss of everything he once had. The drop then represents the anger and resentment that have been building inside him after years of betrayal and imprisonment.

01.title: serendipity
description: • Programmed, Produced & Mixed by Maozon (UMBRL) & Volumetrique (KodamaSounds)

Maozon: I wanted to try my hand at melodic and smooth vocal drum & bass for quite some time. This track could not have existed without any one of those elements: my composition and bass track, Volumetrique’s sound design and ideas, and Renko’s lyrics and vocals. I am deeply grateful to KodamaSounds for giving me this precious opportunity, to my two collaborators, and to everyone who picked up this album and gave it a listen! [予てからメロディックでスムースなボーカルドラムンベースに挑戦したいと思っていました。この楽曲は私の作曲・ベーストラックにVolumetriqueのサウンドデザイン・アイデア、そしてRenkoの歌詞とボーカル、どの要素が欠けても存在し得ませんでした。貴重な機会を頂けたKodamaSounds、コラボレーターの二人、そしてこのアルバムを手にとって聴いて頂いた皆様に大変感謝します！]

Volumetrique: I had the honor of working with a Drum and Bass legend from Japan, which I admire a lot, Maozon; as well as a great vocalist and lyricist, Renko. I had lots of fun playing with the slap bass, and learned a lot from my collaborators, which I would like to thank once again for their ideas, feedback and patience. Being able to work on vocals is new to me, but I will keep this experience very close to my heart.

Renko: Thank you for having me on for such a fun and amazing track! It was fun getting to be a part of it and working alongside Maozon & Volumetrique. Shoutout to Julie for calling upon me for this. Not only did they write a melody that was fun to sing and felt like an incredible match, when I listened through for the first time, I knew the kind of lyrics I wanted to write for it. 12.title: Regrind Protocol
description: • Programmed, Produced & Mixed by NotWo [のとを]

• About this track: I composed the track by repeatedly stretching completed sounds and reusing them as basses, glitches, and drums. Drawing on IDM and neurobass, I aimed for a sound design that is more flexible in the temporal dimension. I also focused on keeping the track intense while adhering to the conventions of dance music—fixed kick and snare placements, with the groove defined by the sub-bass in order to fit the compilation’s theme. [完成させた音源を再び引き延ばすことでベースやグリッチ、ドラムとして再利用するというプロセスを繰り返して作成しました。IDMやニューロベースの文脈を利用して、より時間方向に対して柔軟なサウンドデザインを行うことを試みました。また、コンピレーションのテーマに適応するよう、激しく、またダンスミュージックのフォーマット（キックとスネアを定点で鳴らし、サブベースによってグルーヴが規定される）を順守することも意識しました。]

22.role: Music, Mastering Engineer, Audio Crossfade & Special Thanks

description.en: Do you feel it? The ground shaking beneath your feet? This overwhelming sonic power taking over you? Let the TREMOR guide your steps. Let the sound waves carry your convictions. TREMOR's a compilation to listen through when you want nothing but the most exciting sounds. On one side, a photovoltaic barrage of pure violence pierces through you. On the other side, a strange, bittersweet emotional surge resonates deep within you. The power of BASS is all that matters - in all different kinds of shapes and forms.
description.jp: 足元で大地が震えているのを感じるか？全身を呑み込んでいく、この圧倒的な音の力を感じるか？己の歩みを、TREMORに委ねろ。その信念を、音の波に乗せろ。TREMOR――それは、ただひたすらに刺激的な音を求めるときに聴くコンピレーション。片側からは、太陽光発電の砲撃のような純粋な暴力性を持つサウンドが身体を貫く。もう片側からは、どこか奇妙で、ほろ苦い感情の奔流が、深く心の奥底へと響き渡る。重要なのは、ただひとつ。BASSの力。何の形でも。
